about.description: GUB Competitive Programming Community (GUBCPC) is the premier programming club of Green University of Bangladesh. Founded with the mission to foster algorithmic thinking and competitive programming culture among students, we have been nurturing talent since our inception.
about.mission: To create a thriving competitive programming culture at Green University of Bangladesh by providing resources, mentorship, and opportunities for students to excel in algorithmic problem solving.
about.vision: To be recognized as one of the leading competitive programming communities in Bangladesh, producing top-tier programmers who compete at national and international levels.
